sent.text: Write a complaint to Amazon about my broken headphones

assistant.content:
You bought headphones from Amazon that are broken, so you want to complain about this issue.

Amazon, as an e-commerce entity, must have a grievance officer who should acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within one month. [1]

You can file a consumer complaint online on the e-Jagriti portal without paying a fee if the amount paid is up to Rs 5 lakh. [2]

If you want to escalate the matter to a Consumer Commission, you should file the complaint within two years of the problem arising, or else you need to show sufficient cause for delay. [3]

Before I can draft this I still need: Amount paid, Purchase date, What you want.

Next: How much did you pay?

citations.title: E-commerce grievance officer
citations.caveat: One month is the redressal timeline for the grievance, not a universal refund deadline.
citations.summary: Every e-commerce entity must appoint a grievance officer and show their contact details on the platform. The officer must acknowledge a complaint within 48 hours and redress it within one month of receiving it.

citations.title: Filing a consumer complaint online
citations.caveat: Check the portal's current fee table before filing.
citations.locator: Portal home; fee schedule under the Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
citations.summary: Consumer complaints are filed online on e-Jagriti, which replaced e-Daakhil from 1 January 2025. No fee is charged at the District Commission when the amount paid is up to Rs 5 lakh.
citations.citation: e-Jagriti portal, Department of Consumer Affairs

citations.title: Time limit for a consumer complaint
citations.caveat: When the cause of action arose is a legal question. If you are close to two years, speak to a lawyer now.
citations.summary: A Consumer Commission will normally not admit a complaint filed more than two years after the cause of action arose. A late complaint can be admitted only if you show sufficient cause and the Commission records its reasons.
